annotations.title: Get relay leaderboard for a model

description: For one model, list the monitored relays that sell it, one row per relay using its highest-uptime group: input/output/cache price per 1M tokens in the relay's own currency (CNY or USD), 24h uptime and latency. Sorted by uptime, then price. Paged with limit and offset: total, returned, hasMore and nextOffset say whether the page is complete, and coversAllRelays is true only when it holds the whole board. This is not a price ranking and includes USD-priced relays and promotional groups; for the lowest price under an uptime condition use find_cheapest_relay.

locale.description: Language of the human-readable text (statement, reason, notes, suggestions) and of the OkkMax page links. Pass zh when the user writes Chinese, otherwise en. Field names and data values are the same either way.

model.description: Model slug as used on OkkMax, e.g. claude-opus-5-5 or gpt-6-astra. Dated aliases and other spellings of the same version (4.6 for 4-6) are accepted and resolved to the canonical slug. Use search_models to find slugs.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Use nextOffset from the previous response while hasMore is true.

name: get_model_board

coversAllRelays.description: true only when this response contains every relay on the board (offset 0 and hasMore false). Only then may the rows be treated as the full candidate set.

dataAsOf.description: ISO 8601 time the underlying OkkMax data was last updated (not the time of this response). null when unavailable.

hasMore.description: true when more rows exist after this page. Request nextOffset to continue.

requestedModel.description: Present only when the requested slug was another spelling of the canonical model; model then holds the canonical slug.

totalRelays.description: Number of relays on the whole board (same as total).
